description: This PHP source file defines the ListViewData class used for managing list view data in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for fetching list data with pagination, sorting, additional details via AJAX, and URL generation for navigation within list views.

classes.name: ListViewData
classes.description: A class for managing and retrieving data for list views in SuiteCRM, including sorting, pagination, additional details, and URL management for list view navigation.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Determines the ordering field and direction for list view data, based on request parameters, session, or user preferences.

methods.name: getReverseSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the reverse of a given sort order ('ASC' to 'DESC' or vice versa).

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the configured limit of rows per list view page.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Calculates the current offset for pagination, based on request parameters.

methods.name: getBaseQuery
methods.description: Constructs the base URL query parameters for list view navigation, filtering out specific variables.

methods.name: setVariableName
methods.description: Sets variable names for request/session variables associated with list view state, based on module and list view context.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Executes a count query to determine the total number of records matching the current list view criteria.

methods.name: getListViewData
methods.description: Main method to fetch list view data, including sorting, pagination, additional details, and processing of rows for display.

methods.name: generateURLS
methods.description: Generates full URLs for pagination and sorting navigation based on query parameters.

methods.name: generateQueries
methods.description: Creates the set of URL query parameters for pagination and sorting controls.

methods.name: getAdditionalDetailsAjax
methods.description: Prepares the HTML snippet to trigger AJAX loading of additional record details.

methods.name: getAdditionalDetails
methods.description: Generates the HTML content for additional record details, including view/edit links and inline info.
